comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
"Pocket Watch". Available from the Astronomy Premium Bottle (released on 7/8). An accessory item, it gives +1 to Astronomy skill... and that's pretty much it. Technically outclassed by the 12 Zodiac accessories, but points for having a stylish icon, I guess.

Source: wiki.ogplanet.com/uwo/index.php?title=Astronomy_Premium_Bottle

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Kinda interested in owning one for the sake of novelty, so if anybody has this, drop me a line or, if I'm not on, leave IGN. (I do have one of the aforementioned Zodiac +1 Astronomy accessories, but I have a thing for collecting items like this.)
